subject.title: feat(googlechat): opt-in dmThreadMode to thread DM replies

question: Should Google Chat DM thread replies be accepted as a separate `dmThreadMode` account key, or should this work be folded into the existing `replyToMode` or broader `threadSessions` threading API instead?
rationale: The PR is not only a code repair: it adds a public config surface next to existing thread controls and an overlapping open thread-session PR, so automation cannot safely choose the long-term product API.

options.title: Consolidate with existing threading surface
options.body: Use one Google Chat threading/session API for DM thread behavior unless maintainers explicitly want a separate reply-only knob.

options.title: Accept separate `dmThreadMode`
options.body: Keep the PR direction, but require the exported type, generated metadata, docs, and redacted real Google Chat proof before merge.

options.title: Pause for broader thread-session work
options.body: Leave this PR open or close it later only if a proven, mergeable canonical thread-session PR replaces the behavior.

recommendation.title: Consolidate with existing threading surface
recommendation.body: Use one Google Chat threading/session API for DM thread behavior unless maintainers explicitly want a separate reply-only knob.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior maintainer verification and Google Chat thread-send history make this the strongest available owner for the API-direction call.
